---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea — keep in mind the scope (personal watchlist, no sharing, no mobile app).
labels: enhancement
---

**The problem**
What aren't you able to do today?

**Sketch of a solution**
Even a rough one. UI ideas are welcome.

**Have you tried**
- The natural-language Find mode (⌘K → Tab)
- The filter rail (genre, year, rating, runtime, provider)
- Settings → Search to swap to a stronger LLM (Anthropic / OpenAI / Google)

**Anything else**
Links to similar features in other apps, screenshots, etc.
